name: Moonwell
fix_description: getChainlinkPrice lacks a staleness check on the oracle response. The contract used a delisted Chainlink market rate feed for wrsETH that returned an abnormal price (~$5.8B). Add require(block.timestamp - updatedAt < MAX_STALENESS) and validate price is within reasonable bounds. Use the exchange rate feed instead of the delisted market rate feed.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving a flash loan, depositing manipulated collateral into Moonwell, borrowing against the mispriced asset, and routing swaps across multiple concentrated-liquidity pools to unwind and repay. While the PoC is not very long, it requires understanding protocol-specific collateral valuation/oracle behavior and Uniswap V3-style callback mechanics, making it more than a straightforward single-bug exploit.
